mediaPage.title: Media
mediaPage.intro: Upload images, maintain alt text, see where assets are used, or restore removed assets.

mediaPicker.title: Choose an image
mediaPicker.closeConfirm: Uploads or unsaved alt text and notes are still pending. Closing stops waiting and discards unsaved input; uploaded assets are kept. Close anyway?

mediaLibrary.uploadRules: Static JPEG, PNG and WebP up to 8 MB each. Uploads are optimized to WebP and stripped of metadata.
mediaLibrary.uploadPrivacy: Asset links are publicly accessible. Your original files stay on your computer.
mediaLibrary.defaultAlt: Default alt text for new images
mediaLibrary.searchPlaceholder: Search file names, alt text or notes
mediaLibrary.usageHint: “In use” covers drafts, archives, comments and past revisions. Editing notes does not change where an asset is used.

references.heading: {name} · Used in
references.hint: Includes drafts, archives and past revisions. Only assets that are not used anywhere can be removed.
references.none: This asset is not used by any content or past revision.

batch.selectHint: Selects this page only. Changing pages, filtering or refreshing clears the selection.
batch.removeHint: Media still used by current content or past revisions is kept, with its usage listed.
batch.summary: Bulk removal finished: {removed} moved to trash, {referenced} kept, {failed} failed
batch.hintNoSelection: Select the assets on this page you want to move to trash.
batch.hintLoading: Bulk removal is available once the media library has loaded.
batch.hintBusy: An upload or another action is in progress. Bulk removal is available when it finishes.
batch.hintPendingJobs: Some uploads are unfinished. Retry or remove them before bulk removal.
batch.hintDirty: Save your alt text or note changes before bulk removal.
batch.hintOwnership: The signed-in account or content library has changed. Reload the media library before bulk removal.

removal.referenced: Kept because it is in use

mediaMessages.ownership: The signed-in account or content library has changed. Your files, alt text and notes are kept. Switch back to the original account and library and reload, or reopen the media workspace.
mediaMessages.stillLoading: The media library is still loading. Please wait before choosing files.
mediaMessages.loadFirst: Load the media library before doing that.
mediaMessages.operationFailed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
mediaMessages.loginRequired: Sign in with the owner account. The media library is for administrators only.
mediaMessages.loadFailed: Couldn't load media. Check that you're signed in, or try again.
mediaMessages.saveDraftsFirst: Save or discard your alt text and note changes first.
mediaMessages.discardDraftsConfirm: Alt text or notes have unsaved changes. Discard them and change the filter?
mediaMessages.tooManyFiles: You can choose up to 10 images at a time.
mediaMessages.invalidFile: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP no larger than 8 MB.
mediaMessages.altSaveFailed: Couldn't save alt text. Your input is kept.
mediaMessages.descriptionSaveFailed: Couldn't save notes. Your input is kept.
mediaMessages.referencesFailed: Couldn't load usage. Please try again.
mediaMessages.referencedResult: Still used in {total} places (incl. past revisions); not moved to trash
mediaMessages.removedResult: Moved to trash; can be restored
mediaMessages.removeFailedRecheck: {message}. Reload to check whether it was moved to trash.
mediaMessages.checkFailed: Couldn't check usage, so nothing was removed: {message}
mediaMessages.batchConfirm: Move the unused assets among the {count} selected images to trash? Assets still in use are kept and their usage listed. Trashed links stop working; files are kept and can be restored.
mediaMessages.stillReferenced: This asset is still in use and can't be removed.
mediaMessages.removeConfirm: Move this image to trash? Its link will stop working; the file is kept and can be restored.
mediaMessages.removeFailed: Couldn't remove the asset. Please try again.
mediaMessages.restoreFailed: Couldn't restore the asset. Check file storage and try again.
mediaMessages.leaveBatchConfirm: Bulk removal is still running. Leaving stops the remaining steps; requests already sent may have taken effect. Come back to the media library and reload to check the results. Leave anyway?
mediaMessages.leaveDirtyConfirm: Uploads or unsaved alt text and notes are still pending. Leaving stops waiting and discards unsaved input; uploaded assets are kept. Leave anyway?
mediaMessages.stayBatch: Stayed in the media library: bulk removal continues and results will appear when it finishes.
mediaMessages.stayDirty: Stayed in the media library: uploads and unsaved notes are kept. Leave after they finish or are saved.

mediaUpload.ownership: The signed-in account or content library has changed. Your file is kept; check and try again.
mediaUpload.cancelled: Upload cancelled. The selected file is kept.
mediaUpload.loginRequired: Sign in again and retry. The selected file is kept.
mediaUpload.network: Network error during upload. The file is kept; you can retry.
mediaUpload.timeout: Upload timed out. You can retry with the same file.
